EA Sports FC 27 - Official Gameplay Overview Trailer
Take a look at the Gameplay Deep Dive for EA Sports FC 27, the latest addition to the football (soccer) simulation game developed by EA Canada and EA Romania. Players can get the rundown on key gameplay additions, tweaks, and features being implemented with the new release. Access dynamic corners, enhanced attacking awareness, player-focused defending tailored for competitive play, and more. EA Sports FC 27 is launching on September 25 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).

text:
Your Name: Exclusive 10th Anniversary 4K Re-Release Trailer
In celebration of its 10th anniversary, the globally beloved film YOUR NAME is coming to North American theatres nationwide in a new 4K remaster beginning August 14 in both its original Japanese language and English dub. GKIDS, the Academy Award-winning producer and distributor of acclaimed and artist-driven animation from around the world, also debuted a new trailer ahead of its theatrical release.

The 2016 feature is an original anime film, directed and written by Makoto Shinkai (Suzume, Weathering with You) and animated by CoMix Wave Films. Upon its original release, it swiftly became a global phenomenon, and went on to receive global critical acclaim, awards, and accolades, including winning 2016 Sitges - Catalonian International Film Festival’s “Best Animated Feature Film”; 2017 Awards of the Japanese Academy “Best Animation”, “Best Screenplay”, “Best Director” and “Best Music Score”; 2016 Los Angeles Film Critics Association Awards “Best Animation”, and more. The film remains the highest-grossing original Japanese animated feature of all time, with a worldwide box office of over $400 million. A breathtaking love story across time, veteran and new fans alike will be able to fully immerse themselves in the beauty of YOUR NAME. in its 4K remaster.

GKIDS handles distribution for a number of Makoto Shinkai’s seminal films, including Weathering With You, Children Who Chase Lost Voices, 5 Centimeters Per Second, The Place Promised in our Early Days and Voices of a Different Star. YOUR NAME. joins these beloved titles from Makoto Shinkai in the GKIDS catalog.

One morning, rural schoolgirl Mitsuha and city kid Taki awaken to discover that they’ve switched bodies. The total strangers struggle to navigate each other’s lives, walking tightropes of intimacy and distance. But when they finally resolve to meet, the true nature of their connection threatens to seal their fate.
